protein quality control mechanisms, including the unfolded protein responses of various sub-cellular compartments, are important for cellular health and viability, that these mechanisms are induced in aging and in response to stress and, finally, that the induction of these mechanisms can increase lifespan in organisms ranging from yeast to flies and mice.

the mechanisms of cellular stress resistance and the role that these mechanisms play in aging.

the stress response is not futile, but rather is a key determinant of longevity.

the protein quality control system is a major determinant of longevity, and that it may be possible to manipulate it for therapeutic benefit in aging and age-related disease.
